card.name: Just before granulocyte or tissue terms
card.fires_on: Small connecting marks (an opening parenthesis, "as", a space, a digit) right before the model expects "granulocyte", "G-CSF" or a similar growth-factor term. It also shows up in section numbers and brand names within oncology labels.

modes.label: Before G-CSF names
modes.description: A parenthesis or "such as" that leads into G-CSF or granulocyte growth-factor names.

modes.label: Section numbers and spaces
modes.description: A digit or space inside cross-reference numbers or dose figures in label text.
modes.example: Wound Healing Complications [see Warnings and Precautions (<<5>>.2) ].

card.writes: It pushes toward words like "gran", "tissue" and "vascular".
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to name a granulocyte growth factor such as G-CSF, and sometimes at reference numbers.
